title: Basic Police Academy
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 30S/45Q to fewer than 60S/90Q units

program.section_heading: Basic Police Academy, Certificate of Achievement - Major #8921
outcomes: Demonstrate knowledge of California laws pertaining to arrest authority of a peace officer and a citizen covered under Penal Code sections 836 and 837.
Compare and contrast the constitutional issues involved in detentions, arrest and interrogations.
Demonstrate physical competency in psychomotor skills in handling police weaponry in a safe manner.
Demonstrate the ability to communicate effectively and professionally through written, oral and electronic media.

Identify the California laws that pertain to the enforcement and procedural aspects of law enforcement, recognizing the violations an officer is likely to encounter and describe the legal obligations in enforcing those laws.
Identify the process to confine and care for adult or juvenile prisoners in such a manner as to provide the necessary confinement and to protect the prisoner's rights and welfare.

notes: The catalog prints 19 units for AJ 270A, while the state Program Course File stores 19.5; the catalog's printed total of 36.5 matches 19 + 17.5. The value is recorded as printed.
The source URL path references the 2025-2026 FCC Catalog, although the requested catalog year is 2026-2027; a reviewer should verify the year.
The description mentions employment in 'government and private enterprise where law enforcement principles are applied'. These are sectors rather than named careers, so no careers were recorded.
The text lists the entry requirements (applications, the POST exam, the physical agility test, DMV and DOJ clearance, and a physical exam). These are admission conditions, not course requirements.
